name: fafo-pane
description: FAFO pane: shows the agent and CI flow in Claude Code's sidebar by reading the views.json the FAFO collector writes. Read only, no subprocess.

viewsPath.title: views.json path
viewsPath.description: Absolute path of the FAFO views.json, or ~/ followed by a path under your home folder. The file name must be exactly views.json and the path must not contain .., . or empty parts; anything else is refused. Empty uses $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/fafo/views.json, else ~/.local/state/fafo/views.json.
